Wesley Fofana , who had been booked only minutes earlier, received a second yellow card and was sent off. Despite being down to ten men, Chelsea pushed forward, introducing fresh legs like Liam Delap . The final minutes were marred by a flurry of yellow cards for players such as Enzo Fernandez , Joao Pedro , and Cole Palmer as tensions boiled over. Ultimately, Sunderland held firm in front of 47,155 fans to secure the victory in a match defined by its physical edge and late-game drama.
